definitions: Raised marks on the skin, often caused by a blow, allergic reaction, or insect bite.
A strip of material sewn into a seam to strengthen or decorate it, especially in shoes or garments.
The edge of a knitted fabric, especially a sock, that is turned over and sewn to form a neat, strong finish.
examples: The child had red welts on his arm after touching the nettles.
The shoemaker carefully stitched the welts onto the leather boots.
She pulled up her socks, adjusting the welts around her ankles.
